provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft with host review/repairs, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.explanation:
The constructor builds an s x 3s strip made of three tiles. The left and right tiles are identical to the output. The middle tile is optionally flipped vertically. The native rule copies the left third onto a canvas pre-filled with the background.

Under any D4 transform, the two outer thirds map to the two outer thirds along the long axis. Each of them still equals the transformed output, because the original left and right thirds are identical copies of the tile. So the output in visible coordinates is the first third along the long axis.

For d4%4 in {0,2} the strip stays horizontal, so the program keeps all rows and the first w//3 columns. For d4%4 in {1,3} the strip becomes vertical, so it keeps all columns and the first h//3 rows. As a safety check, the axis is overridden by the grid's shape if the two disagree; for s>=2 the long axis is always unambiguous.

The background-filled canvas stage is kept, with the background taken as the most common colour. Colours are copied verbatim, so the palette needs no constants.
draft_notes.limitations: Assumes the generator's domain: an s x 3s strip (or 3s x s after rotation) with s>=2 and the outer thirds identical. No fixture contradictions were found. The fixtures were not executed; no tests have been run.
